svcRecrutare.title: Staff recruitment, from A to Z
svcRecrutare.subtitle: We find the right people for you, from defining the role to the final interview. You run your business — we handle the entire recruitment flow.

includes.title: Profile analysis and initial consulting
includes.text: We talk with you, understand exactly who you need and define the role clearly before the search begins.

includes.title: Active candidate sourcing
includes.text: We don't wait for applications. We go out and find the right candidates where they are.

includes.title: Rigorous screening with structured interviews
includes.text: Every candidate goes through structured interviews, so only serious people reach your desk.

includes.title: You stay involved in the final selection
includes.text: Your hiring manager and team take part in the final choice. The decision always stays with you.

includes.title: Support across the whole flow, up to hiring
includes.text: Scheduling, candidate communication, feedback — we handle it all, so your internal resources stay free.

includes.title: 30-day replacement guarantee
includes.text: If the person you hire leaves within the first 30 days, we replace them.

forWho: You run a construction or production company and people leave faster than you can hire.
You've been searching for months for a key role and can't find the right person.
You have no HR department and recruitment eats up time you should spend on your business.
You once hired in a hurry and paid for it. This time you want the selection done properly.

steps.title: Tell us who you need
steps.text: We discuss the role, the team and your expectations, and define the right candidate profile together.

steps.title: We search and screen
steps.text: Active sourcing and structured interviews. We only bring you candidates worth meeting.

steps.title: You hire with peace of mind
steps.text: You join the final interview and make the choice. If the person leaves within 30 days, we replace them.

faq.q: How long does it take to find a candidate?
faq.a: It depends on the role and how in-demand that profile is. After our first talk, we give you a realistic timeline for your situation.

faq.q: What happens if the new hire leaves quickly?
faq.a: You're covered by the replacement guarantee: if the person leaves within the first 30 days, we search again and bring you another candidate.

faq.q: Do I have to run the interviews myself?
faq.a: Only the final one, if you wish. We handle the screening and structured interviews — you only meet the right candidates. You're involved exactly as much as you want.

faq.q: How much does recruitment cost?
faq.a: The price depends on the role and how complex the search is. Tell us what you're looking for and we'll send you a concrete offer.

svcRecrutare.ctaText: Tell us which role you need to fill and we'll come back with a concrete proposal.

includes.title: HR Administration

includes.title: Legal Compliance
includes.text: Internal audit, support with labor legislation and internal policies set up properly, so there are no surprises.

includes.title: Performance and Retention
includes.text: Assessments, team feedback and employer branding strategies, so your good people stay with you.

forWho: Your company is growing and HR paperwork is starting to overwhelm you.
You can't justify a full-time HR person yet, but you feel you need one.
Good people keep leaving and you're not sure why.
You want to be sure you're in line with labor legislation, without studying it yourself.

steps.title: We look at where you are
steps.text: Together we review your current HR: documents, contracts, policies, team.

steps.title: We agree on what we take over
steps.text: You choose what to hand over: administration, compliance, assessments — or the full package.

steps.title: We run it, you stay informed
steps.text: We do the work and keep you updated step by step. You decide, we execute.

faq.q: Can you fully replace an HR department?
faq.a: We can take over the essential HR processes: personnel administration, compliance, assessments. You choose whether to outsource everything or just a part.

faq.q: My company is small. Does this make sense for me?
faq.a: Yes. Small companies rarely have a dedicated HR person, and paperwork and legislation need constant attention. You outsource exactly as much as you need, without hiring anyone.

faq.q: What does an internal HR audit mean?
faq.a: We review your HR documents and processes — contracts, job descriptions, internal policies — and tell you clearly what's fine and what needs fixing.

faq.q: How much does HR consulting cost?
faq.a: It depends on your team size and on which processes we take over. Message us and we'll send an offer for your situation.

svcHr.ctaText: Tell us what you're struggling with on the people side and we'll propose a concrete plan.

includes.title: Company Formation & Registration

includes.title: Legal Documentation Assistance

includes.title: Tax Registration & Compliance

includes.title: Registered Office & Administrative Support

includes.title: Banking & Financial Setup Guidance

forWho: Foreign entrepreneurs who want to open a company in Romania

steps.title: Tell us your plan
steps.desc: Write to us on WhatsApp. We listen, ask a few questions and tell you exactly what your company setup needs.

steps.title: We prepare everything
steps.desc: Documents, translations, registrations, visits to institutions — we handle the paperwork and keep you updated at every step.

faq.q: Do I need to travel to Romania to open the company?

faq.a: No. We communicate with you in English and coordinate certified translations for all the documents that need them.

faq.q: What about taxes and VAT?
faq.a: We assist with tax and VAT registration and explain, in plain words, what fiscal obligations your company will have in Romania — so there are no surprises.

faq.q: Do I need an address in Romania for the company?
faq.a: Yes, every Romanian company needs a registered office. We support you in finding a solution and handle the related administrative steps.

svcCetatenie.title: Romanian citizenship reacquisition
svcCetatenie.subtitle: Reclaiming or obtaining Romanian citizenship means archives, apostilles, translations and a lot of waiting. We guide your file from the first document all the way to the oath.

includes.title: File Audit & Eligibility Verification
includes.desc: We carefully analyse the documents you already have, check their accuracy and eligibility, spot what's missing and tell you how to fix it.

includes.title: Archival Research
includes.desc: We search the archives for the certificates and historical records your file needs — essential when reclaiming Romanian citizenship.

includes.title: Apostille & Certified Translation Management
includes.desc: We manage the complete legalisation and translation process, so your documents are officially accepted where they need to go.

includes.title: International Background Checks
includes.desc: We support you in obtaining and verifying the international criminal record, guiding you through the required steps and helping you avoid common mistakes.

includes.title: ANC Status Tracking
includes.desc: We monitor your file at the National Authority for Citizenship (ANC), keep you constantly updated and step in when delays or blockages appear.

includes.title: Oath Preparation & Language Guidance
includes.desc: We prepare you for the final stage with Romanian language support and oath simulations, so you walk in calm and ready.

includes.title: Post-Citizenship Registration
includes.desc: We handle the transcription of your civil status documents (birth, marriage) into the Romanian registry, so they are officially recognised in Romania.

includes.title: Power of Attorney Representation
includes.desc: We can represent you at institutions through power of attorney — we handle the administrative steps and reduce the need for you to travel.

forWho: Descendants of Romanian citizens who want to reclaim their citizenship
Foreign citizens starting the Romanian citizenship process
People with a file already submitted who need tracking and support
Anyone living abroad who can't manage the Romanian paperwork alone

steps.title: We check your file
steps.desc: You tell us your situation on WhatsApp. We audit your documents and tell you honestly where you stand and what's still missing.

steps.title: We build the file together
steps.desc: Archive research, translations, apostilles, criminal records — we gather and prepare everything, then track your file at the ANC.

steps.title: You take the oath
steps.desc: We prepare you for the oath, then register your civil documents in Romania. You are officially a Romanian citizen.

faq.q: How long does the citizenship process take?
faq.a: There is no fixed term — it depends on your case, how complete your file is and the processing pace at the authorities. What we can do: prepare a correct file from day one, track its status at the ANC and intervene when it gets stuck, so you avoid the delays that can be avoided.

faq.q: What documents do I need?
faq.a: Typically: civil status certificates (birth, marriage), documents proving your connection to Romania, and a criminal record — all translated and apostilled. Every case is different, so we start with a file audit and give you the exact list for your situation.

faq.q: Do I have to come to Romania in person?
faq.a: Not for every step. For many administrative procedures we can represent you through power of attorney. Certain key moments, such as the citizenship oath, do require your presence — we tell you from the start exactly when you'll need to travel.

faq.q: Do I need to speak Romanian for the oath?
faq.a: The oath is taken in Romanian, and basic knowledge of the language helps a lot. That's exactly why we offer language support and oath simulations — so you arrive prepared and confident.

svcCetatenie.ctaTitle: Ready to start your citizenship journey?
svcCetatenie.ctaText: Send us a message on WhatsApp with your situation. We'll tell you honestly what your file needs and how we can help.

svcMediere.title: Mediation for workplace disputes
svcMediere.subtitle: When a conflict appears between an employee and an employer, court is not the only way. Mediation is a calmer path: you sit down with a neutral mediator, talk openly and look for a solution that works for both sides.
includes: Mediation for employee–employer conflicts, with a neutral, impartial mediator
Guided negotiation, built on the real needs of both sides, not on rigid positions
A mediation agreement with legal value — it can become enforceable through notarial authentication or court approval
Full confidentiality: what is said in mediation stays in mediation
Tax benefit: if a court case is already under way, you can recover 50% of the stamp duty
forWho: Employees in conflict with their employer who want a quick solution, without a trial
Employers who want to settle a dispute without drama and without going to court
Companies that prefer dialogue over a long, tiring legal battle

steps.title: You tell us your situation
steps.text: Message us on WhatsApp or give us a call. We listen to what happened and tell you honestly whether mediation fits your case.

steps.title: The mediation session
steps.text: You sit down at the table with the mediator. The discussion is voluntary, confidential and focused on a solution where both sides win.

steps.title: The mediation agreement
steps.text: If you reach an understanding, we put it in writing as a mediation agreement. If needed, it can become enforceable through a notary or the court.

faq.q: What exactly is mediation?
faq.a: It is a structured conversation between you and the other side, guided by a neutral, impartial mediator. Nobody imposes a solution: you decide together, and the mediator helps you understand each other. Everything is voluntary and confidential.

faq.q: How long does mediation take compared to court?
faq.a: A court case can take a long time. Mediation is usually much faster: it can be settled in a few meetings, at the parties' own pace. That is why it is worth trying before going to court.

faq.q: Do I have to bring a lawyer?
faq.a: No. In mediation, the mediator is neutral and takes no one's side. You can bring a lawyer if it makes you feel safer, but it is not mandatory.

faq.q: What legal value does the mediation agreement have?
faq.a: The agreement signed in mediation is a private document. To become enforceable, it can be authenticated by a notary or approved by the court through a ruling. We explain step by step which option fits your situation.

svcMediere.ctaText: Message us on WhatsApp and tell us your situation. We will tell you honestly whether mediation can help and what the next steps would be.

about.title: About us
about.intro: Full Work Services is a recruitment and HR firm based in Bucharest. We handle the whole process, from finding the right candidates to the final interview, with a focus on transparency and collaboration. Behind the firm is Diana Dina, our founder, with over 15 years of experience in human resources — and the belief that HR is first of all about relationships between people, not just processes.
vision: We believe something simple: people work well where they are treated with respect. That's why we tell companies the truth from the first conversation, and give candidates real answers instead of silence.
We don't rush to "deliver CVs". We'd rather understand the role, the team and the person first — and only then make a recommendation we can stand behind.
And our job doesn't end when the contract is signed. We stay close after the hire too, because a good match shows over time, not on interview day.

values.title: Transparency
values.text: We tell it like it is, from the very first message. No inflated promises and no hidden conditions — you always know where you stand and what comes next.

values.title: Respect for the candidate
values.text: You are not a CV in a pile. We listen to you, give you real feedback and treat you as a person, not a file.

values.title: Long-term partnership
values.text: We don't disappear once the contract is signed. We stay close to both companies and people, because good relationships are built over time.

faq.q: Does it cost me anything to apply or get hired through you?
faq.a: No. For candidates, our services are free — from the first message until you are hired.

faq.q: How long until I get hired?
faq.a: It depends on the job and the employer, but we never leave you guessing: we contact you within 24 hours of applying and keep you updated at every step.

faq.q: What documents do I need?
faq.a: Usually your ID card or passport, plus diplomas or qualifications if the job requires them. Don't worry in advance: we tell you exactly what is needed and help you prepare everything.

faq.q: Is a job abroad safe?
faq.a: Yes, when it is done right. You only leave with an official work contract and conditions known in advance, and where applicable, housing and transport are arranged. We also stay in touch after you arrive.

faq.q: Can I apply without a CV?
faq.a: Of course. Write to us, we talk on the phone, and if needed, we help you put your experience on paper.

candidates.ctaTitle: Let's find you the right job
candidates.ctaText: Send us a WhatsApp message with what you can do and what you are looking for. We will contact you within 24 hours.

p: We respect your data. We only collect what you share with us through our forms — name, phone, email, message and, if you apply for a job, your CV. We never sell your data and we do not send you ads.
Below you will find a plain-language explanation of what we do with your data and what rights you have.

The controller of your data is FULL WORK SERVICES S.R.L., with its registered office at Str. Grigore Ionescu no. 63, Sector 2, Bucharest, Romania, Trade Register no. J2021020993406, tax ID (CUI) 45291775.
For any question about your data, write to us at office@fullworkservices.com or call +40 723 147 723.
Through the contact or quote request form: your name, phone, email and message.
When you apply for a job on the site: your name, phone, email and the CV you upload.
If you message us on WhatsApp, the conversation takes place in the WhatsApp app, at your initiative, and is also subject to WhatsApp's privacy policy.
That is all. We do not collect data behind your back and we do not use tracking or marketing cookies.
To reply to your messages and quote requests.
To help you find a job: we read your CV, contact you for an interview and present your application to the employer for the job you applied to.
To keep a basic record of the requests we receive and to meet our legal obligations.
When you contact us or request a quote, we process your data to take steps at your request before a possible contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
When you apply for a job, we process your data based on your consent and on the steps taken at your request with a view to employment (Art. 6(1)(a) and (b) GDPR).
For keeping basic records we rely on our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) — for example, being able to show that we answered your request.

sections.h: How long we keep your data
p: CVs and job application data: a maximum of 12 months from the date you apply. After that we delete them, unless you explicitly ask us to keep them for future opportunities.
Messages from the contact form: for as long as needed to handle your request, plus a reasonable record-keeping period.
You can ask us to delete your data earlier at any time — see the section on your rights.

sections.h: Who else has access to your data
p: Like any modern website, we work with a few technical providers that process data on our behalf, under contract:
Supabase — database hosting, on servers located in the European Union. This is where form messages and job applications are stored.
Vercel — website hosting.
Google Fonts are served directly from our own server, so your visit does not send any data to Google.
If you choose to message us on WhatsApp, the communication goes through the WhatsApp service, at your initiative.
When you apply for a job, we share your CV and contact details with the respective employer — only for the job you applied to. We never sell or rent your data to anyone.

You have the right to know what data we hold about you (access), to correct it if it is wrong, to ask us to delete it, to restrict processing, to object to processing and to receive your data in a portable format.
Where processing is based on your consent, you can withdraw it at any time. Withdrawal does not affect the processing carried out before that moment.
To exercise any of these rights, write to us at office@fullworkservices.com. We will reply as soon as we can, and no later than one month.
If something about the way we handle your data does not seem right, please write to us first — most issues can be solved quickly.
You also have the right, at any time, to lodge a complaint with the Romanian data protection authority (ANSPDCP): www.dataprotection.ro.

sections.h: Updates to this policy and contact
p: If we make an important change to this policy — for example, if we add an analytics tool to the site — we will update the date above and publish the new version here.
Questions? Write to office@fullworkservices.com, call +40 723 147 723 or visit us at Str. Grigore Ionescu no. 63, Sector 2, Bucharest, Romania.
Cookies are small text files that a website saves in your browser. Some are needed for the site to work; others are used by other websites for ads and tracking.
Good news: this site only uses the first kind — the strictly necessary ones.
Just one type: strictly necessary session cookies, used to sign in to the site's admin panel. These only matter for our team, who update the jobs and the content.
As a regular visitor, you can browse the site without receiving any tracking cookies.
No marketing cookies. No tracking cookies. No analytics tools at this time.
Fonts are served directly from our own server, so no data is sent to third parties even at that level.
